description: [PAID — 0.04 USDC on Base via x402] Deterministic PDF -> per-page plain text + metadata, no OCR, no table extraction, no third-party PDF/OCR vendor — text pulled directly from the PDF's own embedded text objects via pdfjs-dist (Mozilla's own PDF.js, Apache-2.0) running in this process. Pass exactly one of `url` (public http(s) link, SSRF-hardened fetch) or `pdf_base64` (raw base64 bytes). Max 10 MiB, max 40 pages processed per call. Scanned/image-only PDFs return empty page text with a warning, never a fabricated OCR guess. $0.04 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

max_pages.description: Optional; defaults to 40 (the route's own cap).

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).

pdf_base64.description: Raw PDF bytes, base64-encoded. Mutually exclusive with url. Max 10 MiB decoded.

url.description: Public http(s) link to a PDF. Mutually exclusive with pdf_base64.

name: pdf_extract
title: PDF text extraction (pdfjs-dist, no OCR/table/vendor)
